text.name: Snorunt

attacks.name: Ice Shard
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a {Fighting} Pokémon, this attack does 30 more damage.

text.flavor: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

attacks.name: Scalding Block
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

rules.label: Tera
rules.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Vanilluxe

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Frigid Room
abilities.text: Your opponent's Pokémon that have 40 HP or less remaining can't attack.

text.flavor: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

text.name: Cetoddle

attacks.name: Avalanche
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

text.name: Frigibax
text.flavor: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shivery Chill
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may search your deck for up to 2 Basic {Water} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hail Blade
attacks.text: You may discard any amount of {Water} Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Iron Bundle

attacks.name: Interjet
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamic Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
